title: Liking big bands like Ralph Flanagan's
summary: Taste for big bands with many horns, an unnamed trumpet-playing leader, and dislike of present music.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom
